name: World Food Processing dba Puris
old_description: Since 1985, we’ve been on a mission to restore knowledge, control, and trust to our food system. Our pea proteins have some of the highest protein content on the planet, delivering a taste that’s defining what healthy food can be.
about:
World Food Processing, doing business as PURIS, is headquartered in Wilmington, Illinois. The company traces its roots to 1985 when Jerry and Renee Lorenzen founded FTE Genetics and Frontier Seeds. World Food Processing was formally established in 1999 with the construction of its first factory in Oskaloosa, Iowa. The business remains privately held.

PURIS manufactures plant-based protein ingredients, specializing in pea protein isolate, pea starch, pea fiber, and non-GMO soybeans. The company operates six facilities across the Midwest, including a protein isolation plant in Turtle Lake, Wisconsin, a wet milling plant in Dawson, Minnesota, and seed processing locations. It reports 175 employees and works with over 400 growers across 14 states. The company produced the first commercial pea protein isolate in the United States in 2014 and launched the first U.S.-made pea protein in 2015.

PURIS supplies food and beverage manufacturers developing plant-based milk, alternative meats, protein bars, snacks, cereals, and beverages. Its ingredients are used by over 200 brands. The company also provides non-GMO soybean varieties and seeds to farmers.

The company was started to restore knowledge, control, and trust to the food system through sustainable, plant-based ingredients. It emphasizes a vertically integrated model from seed breeding through ingredient manufacturing, aiming to reduce environmental impact and improve nutrition.
